notes.title: New update available!
notes.content:
We have been trying to solve some issues about the game as well as improving it with new and scary surprises. 

Fixed issues:
-Easier way to look for notes all around the first level
-We have removed the Flashlight annoying noise when its battery dies
-Levels 3 and 4 are now easier to finish in less time
-New effects on some levels

Save Eleanor and discover the secrets that her dreams are hiding.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/d62dtTh/ELEONOR-S-NIGHTMARES-25-1.png[/img]
